long_description:
This fun and inspirational weekend is designed for you to experience practices that promote healthy change, clarity and happiness. Through specific tantric yoga sequences, breath work, chanting, mantra and a study of two soul traits, we will together have an experience to remember. This introductory class is the first in a series of 4 and the prerequisite for all other "Yoga for Transformation | Cultivating Our Soul Traits" courses. Dive deeper into the study of yoga as a transformational life path as you experience two 2-hour yoga practices and learn about soul traits one and two.

Jennifer Gray is founder and co-owner of Minneapolis Yoga Training and The Yoga Center Retreat. She has been studying and teaching yoga for more than 25 years. Her passion for tantric yoga began when it transformed her own life. A storyteller and educator, Jen shares her knowledge in an accessible and inspirational way.
